canDoEn: Name gold, a diamond, and jade, and ask if it is authentic.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: This gold is authentic, and the stamp is clear on the inside.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢件金係正貨，內圈個印好清楚。
dialogue.say: This gold is [[əθˈɛntɪk]], and the stamp is clear on the inside.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Is the diamond natural, or is it treated in a lab?
dialogue.glossYue: 呢粒鑽石係咪天然，定係實驗室處理過？
dialogue.say: Is the [[dˈaɪmənd]] [[nˈætʃɚəl]], or is it treated in a lab?

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Yes. It is certified, and the papers are in this folder.
dialogue.glossYue: 係。有證書，文件喺呢個文件夾。
dialogue.say: Yes. It is [[sˈɜtəfˌaɪd]], and the papers are in this folder.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I like this jade, and the color is calm and even.
dialogue.glossYue: 我鍾意呢件玉，顏色好平穩。
dialogue.say: I like this jade, and the color is calm and even.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: This setting is eighteen karat gold, and it holds the stone well.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢個鑲托係十八開金，托住粒石好穩。
dialogue.say: This setting is eighteen [[kˈɛɹət]] gold, and it holds the stone well.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: The gold is heavier than the silver, and you can feel it.
dialogue.glossYue: 金重過銀，你隻手感覺到。
dialogue.say: The gold is heavier than the silver, and you can feel it.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The diamond is shinier than the jade when the light hits it.
dialogue.say: The diamond is shinier than the jade when the light hits it.

understand.prompt: This gold is authentic. 係問緊定係講緊？
understand.explain: authentic 係正貨。玉只係材料，唔好講醫療功效。

understand.prompt: Is the diamond natural? 客人想知？
understand.explain: natural 係天然。處理過要另外講。
karat 呢度係金嘅開。純金先至接近二十四開。

chunks.example: Is the diamond natural, or has somebody treated the stone?

chunks.example: It is certified, so the papers match the piece you chose.

build.promptYue: Tom 問 Is this real gold? 你點講？

roleplay.intro: Tom 企喺展示盤前面。等佢問完先答。玉只講材料，唔好講醫療功效。

turns.expect: This setting is eighteen karat gold.

quiz.prompt: 客人講「This gold is authentic, and the stamp is clear on the inside.」，係咩意思？
客人講「The diamond is shinier than the jade when the light hits it.」，係咩意思？

sound.title: 正貨中間嗰下
sound.note: authentic 中間係 /θ/。舌尖伸喺上下牙中間，輕輕吹氣，唔好讀成 /s/ 或者 /t/。開頭係 ə，唔好讀成 ɔ。白K金唔係鉑金。玉係材料同工藝，唔好講醫療功效。
